user.title: Connect to an AVPro Edge HDMI matrix
user.description: Select the exact matrix model and connect directly to its TCP/Telnet control interface.

data_description.model: Choose AC-MX42-AUHD for four inputs or AC-MX82-AUHD for eight inputs.
data_description.name: Optional. Leave blank to use the selected AVPro model as the device name.
data_description.host: A routable hostname or IP address for the matrix.
data_description.port: The ASCII control port configured in the matrix; normally 23.

labels.title: Input and output labels
labels.description: Assign friendly Home Assistant labels for {model}. They are used in source selectors and entity names and do not change the matrix web-interface Port Alias settings.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect or understand the routing-status response. Verify the address, port, selected model, and matrix firmware.
error.duplicate_input_names: Each input label must be unique.
error.duplicate_output_names: Each output label must be unique.

abort.setup_incomplete: Setup state was lost. Start the integration setup again.

init.title: Matrix model
init.description: Select the physical matrix model. Changing from AC-MX42-AUHD to AC-MX82-AUHD enables Inputs 5–8.

labels.title: Input and output labels
labels.description: Rename the Home Assistant connections for {model}. These labels are separate from the matrix Port Alias settings. The integration reloads automatically after saving.

error.duplicate_input_names: Each input label must be unique.
error.duplicate_output_names: Each output label must be unique.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send one advanced ASCII command to an AC-MX42/82-AUHD.
